items.title: When will there be a flying car in your garage? Not anytime soon.
items.summary: People have been wishing for flying cars since the earliest days of flight and automobiles. Does Tesla’s demonstration earlier this month of a “flying” version of its new Roadster mean we’re close?
items.titleZh: 你的车库里什么时候会有飞行汽车？不会很快。
items.summaryZh: 自从飞行和汽车出现以来，人们就一直希望有飞行汽车。特斯拉本月早些时候展示了其新款Roadster的“飞行”版本，这是否意味着我们已经接近目标？

items.title: What the US Movement Against Data Centers Can Learn From Abroad
items.summary: Paris Marx, author of Hyperscale, has been tracking global data center development for years. The US has a lot to learn from what’s happened everywhere from Ireland to New Zealand.
items.titleZh: 美国反对数据中心运动可以从国外学到什么
items.summaryZh: 《超大规模》的作者Paris Marx多年来一直在跟踪全球数据中心的发展。从爱尔兰到新西兰，美国可以从各地发生的事情中学到很多东西。
